name: Cancel a subscription
summary: Confirm intent, offer a pause once as an alternative, then cancel or route for approval.

sources.title: How do I cancel my subscription?

steps.title: Verify identity
steps.instruction: Verify the patient with email and date of birth.

steps.title: Identify the subscription
steps.instruction: Call get_patient_overview. If several programs are active, ask which one.

steps.title: Confirm intent and ask why
steps.instruction: Confirm they want to cancel and briefly ask the reason. If the reason is side effects or a health concern, the clinical safety rule applies: escalate to the clinician queue as well.

steps.title: Offer a pause once
steps.instruction: Call record_retention_offer, then offer to pause instead (up to 90 days). Offer only once. If they decline, proceed.

steps.title: Cancel
steps.instruction: Call cancel_subscription. Standard plans cancel immediately. Commit & Save plans have a termination fee and go to the support team for approval.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.instruction: Confirm the outcome. Note that orders already processing with the pharmacy will still be delivered.

eligibility.rule: Cancelling does not cancel orders already processing or dispatched.
Commit & Save plans have a termination fee; cancellation needs approval.
Pause must be offered once before cancelling (enforced by the system).

escalation.when: Cancelling due to side effects or health concerns
